{{Quote|[S]uch very different ways of writing as the Aurebesh, the ancient Durese syllabary, the Pre-Corellian alphabet, and the abjad of the Azure Imperium all use symbols from Rakatan sources, rarely in the same ways.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written Word" />}}
The '''Pre-Corellian alphabet''' was a [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] used on<ref name="Written Word" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was derived from the [[Rakatan writing system]] and therefore related to the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet, [[Ancient Durese syllabary|Durese syllabary]], and [[Abjad of the Azure Imperium|Axumite abjad]]. Although it used Rakatan symbols, the structure of the alphabet was completely different from Rakatan, which was logographic.<ref name="Written Word" /> The alphabet shared its name with the [[Pre-Corellian]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Galactic Travel Guide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Despite ultimately being derived from the same source, the Pre-Corellian alphabet did not spread as successfully as Aurebesh. It was used aboard [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] after the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until Aurebesh fully supplanted it. The alphabet's history was eventually described in [[38 ABY]] publication "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" by the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]].<ref name="Written Word" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pre-Corellian alphabet was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an article that was written by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] as a feature of [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace: The Official ''Star Wars'' Fan Club]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written Word" />
